name: Incept
description:
A strategic content generation platform that provides the infrastructure for creating, managing, and publishing educational content across Trilogy's learning applications.

As SVP and architect, I designed the platform architecture addressing three core challenges: curriculum modeling (three-level hierarchy from official standards to app-specific curricula with knowledge graph relationships), AI-powered content generation (canonical authoring format optimized for LLMs with programmatic QTI conversion), and safe publishing workflows (draft/production separation with preview capabilities).

The platform serves a 15-person academic team, replacing direct database edits with proper tooling. Features include a Content Generation SDK with shared utilities (data models, QTI converters, LLM tools), a Second Brain knowledge base for pedagogical principles, and standards-compliant delivery via 1EdTech QTI 3.0. Supports both batch generation for reviewed instructional materials and real-time generation for personalized interventions.
